name: Kerem Yilmaz
bio:
Kerem Yilmaz's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the meticulous precision and high stakes of racing during a university project. His keen eye for detail and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set him apart. Kerem started his career at a local racing team, working his way up from assembly line mechanic to head of quality assurance. 

Throughout his career, Kerem has developed a reputation for being a pragmatic visionary. He believes that quality control is not just about identifying defects, but about proactively preventing them. He emphasizes a collaborative approach, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within his team. Kerem is known for his ability to find innovative solutions to complex technical challenges, ensuring that every component and process meets the highest standards of performance and reliability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A sturdy man with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Has a particular fondness for Turkish coffee, brewing a fresh pot every afternoon.
Insists on personally inspecting the final assembly of critical components.
